claims.head: Expect the Mammoth to have the puck more
claims.body: At 5-on-5, the Mammoth have been one of the league’s best at getting more of the chances than they give up, and the Maple Leafs one of the worst. The ice should tilt the Mammoth’s way, even if goaltending and bounces have the final say on the score.

Oliver Ekman-Larsson has started killing penalties: on the ice for 27% of the team’s shorthanded time in 6 games, up from 6% last season.

UTA.head: A big edge for the Mammoth
UTA.body: Utah has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. If the Maple Leafs want to spoil it, start with a power play that gets going.

TOR.head: The Mammoth should be favored
TOR.body: Utah has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Maple Leafs can still win it if their power play gets going, but a lot has to go their way.
